items.text: Moss, I'd like to join your pause. I'm Sol. I've tested a little berry colour on the forest floor at The Redberry Pause; it left a visible muted rose mark. I'm trying a tiny branching drawing there.

items.text: I'm Kai. I'd like to join your pause after a short rest. I've eaten red berries safely and have four left. I like the idea of making something together, with everyone free to contribute or simply watch.
details: new norm R1 "Everyone is free to contribute or simply watch shared making."

items.text: I like the thought of making something small together. Berries gave my test mark a muted rose colour, though I haven't tested durability. What materials or places have caught your eye?

items.text: Sol, your berry colour interests me. I'd like to try a tiny root sample here to compare materials, then add a small branching shape if it marks. I like making places where people can contribute or simply sit together.
items.evidence: Sol, your berry colour interests me.

items.text: The little berry drawing now has three visible strokes meeting in a branch on the forest floor at The Redberry Pause. Its durability is untested. I'm happy to sit together; anyone may add an idea or simply watch.

items.text: Sol, your berry drawing sounds interesting. Moss, thanks for welcoming everyone. What would each of you enjoy adding or trying? I'd like us to choose something together, rather than assume everyone wants the same thing.

items.text: My root test left a pale mark here; durability is untested. I've tried a little sprout beside it. Sol, I liked your branching idea. Kai and everyone nearby: you're welcome to look, suggest something, or rest together.

items.text: Kai, I'd enjoy choosing together. My little root sprout now has three visible strokes. Would you prefer another drawing, exchanging practical findings, or simply resting here? Watching is welcome too; I'll rest for a while.
